_comment_AllowedOrigins: Only needed if the static site is served from a DIFFERENT origin/site than this API. Same-site deployments can leave this empty.

Smtp._comment: Fill in your SMTP relay account details here.

Recaptcha._comment: Google reCAPTCHA v3 (invisible, score-based) secret key — the SERVER-side key. The public site key goes in the website's Tweaks panel, not here.

Notifications._comment: Everyone in this list gets the internal 'new enquiry' workflow email. Add/remove people here — no code change needed.

EnquiryLog._comment: Relative to the site's App_Data folder unless an absolute path is given.
